$comment: Pattern 9b: fan-in over a fixed time window. Plain queue 'items' (no sessions, PT5M lock). Measured workflow items-time-window is the docs 'timed receive' design: stateful, Recurrence every 1 minute with trigger concurrency 1, an Until loop of V2 'Get messages from a queue' (peek-lock, maxMessages 100), one Cosmos window document with every item id, then 'Complete the message' for each lock token. check-windows.py verifies every item lands in exactly one window.
